summary: Query musescore.com (sheet music search, score/license metadata, official download links) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the musescore-mcp server — one-shot HTTP calls through a signed-in browser tab. Use when you want MuseScore data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
